transcript: I ranked these societies in the way that I did because in my personal beliefs, I fall kind of in the middle, not super conservative, not super liberal. And so I want a society that has rules, that has a government to abide by, but that is not as strict as the institutional utopia, where it's just complete rule of law. But I also don't want something as lax as the moral commonwealth or a faith-based order where there really isn't many laws or rules that govern the society. I think every society needs laws and rules to govern, to keep peace, but there's also certain sustainability, science, innovative measures that can provide a more modernized version of a society. And so I think that the modern green utopia is mostly closer to the world we currently live in, which I'm content with. And so I think that that would be a society in the near future that I would want to live in to be able to have the best quality of life.
